name: Poisoning
description: Something you ate or drank is still in you. Your hands shake and the light is too loud.
remedyNote: A healer can treat it; a specific antidote is better.
onset: Your hands begin to shake, and the light in the doorway is too loud.
daily: The shaking has not passed; every meal is a question you ask your body.
recovery: The tremor leaves your hands first; the light becomes ordinary again.

provenance.notes: A discrete poisoning condition for authored scenes; no universal poison table is claimed.
